B.O.B..name: B.O.B.
B.O.B..summary: B.O.B. (known in Japan as Space Funky B.O.B.) is a video game that was released in 1993. It is a side-scrolling game, a 2D shooter and a platform game.

Congo - The Movie - Secret of Zinj.name: Congo the Movie: The Secret of Zinj
Congo - The Movie - Secret of Zinj.summary: Congo: The Secret of Zinj is an unreleased game based on the hit 1995 movie. The game was cancelled after a short development turnover and play tests indicating that the game was not good enough for release. Also contributing was the fact that the movie didn't gross as much as expected.

Donkey Kong Country 2 - Diddy's Kong Que.name: Donkey Kong Country 2: Diddy's Kong Quest
Donkey Kong Country 2 - Diddy's Kong Que.summary: Donkey Kong Country 2: Diddy's Kong Quest is the sequel to Donkey Kong Country. It was developed by Rare and is one of the best selling Super Nintendo games.

Tecmo Secret of the Stars.name: Tecmo Secret of the Stars
Tecmo Secret of the Stars.summary: In this game you wander around the world map. visiting towns and dungeons, and fighting monsters in turn-based combat viewed from first-person perspective, much like in Dragon Quest games. You'll have two parties at your disposal, and will be able to switch between them at any time. One party is the Aquitallion, the "main" one, and the only one which can access plot-progressing areas. The other parties can be used for visiting dungeons and retrieving valuable items. At a certain point in the game, you'll also be able to build and to manage your own town.
